channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: S Korea shouldn’t apply double standard to inherited political guilt
item.description: When South Korean actress Ha Young spoke on television in August about four generations of doctors in her family, she praised the medical accomplishments of her great-grandfather, Ahn Sang-ho. Subsequent scrutiny linked Ahn to the Daejeong Friendship Association, an organization associated with cooperation with Japanese colonial rule. Ha Young said that she had known only [] The post South Korea.

item.title: ‘Super El Niño’ projected to cause 15,800 additional heat deaths in India, says report
item.description: ‘This year’s El Niño is also a ‘postcard from our future’, bringing temperatures climate change is projected to deliver 20 years in the future. In this way, it offers a glimpse at what lies ahead without new investments in adaptation,’ the Climate Impact Lab says in a statement accompanying the report ‘Super El Niño’ projected to cause 15,800 additional heat deaths in India, says report.

item.title: Zelenskyy, at UN, urges leaders to keep choking Russia’s revenues and impede its war efforts
item.description: ‘When someone gives Russia more money through trade, they give this war more time; and that is exactly why we insist on limiting trade with the aggressor, and why we are burning Russia's revenues ourselves,’ said Volodymyr Zelenskyy Zelenskyy, at UN, urges leaders to keep choking Russia’s revenues and impede its war efforts.

item.title: Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction
item.description: At a meeting of the group’s board in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, the governors unveiled a 66-project blueprint to get things started while acknowledging enormous hurdles that must still be overcome Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction.

item.title: Iranian advisers helped Houthis seize Yemen's Red Sea coast in less than 48 hours: report
item.description: The key port city of Mokha was abandoned as residents left in the night, allowing the Houthis to roll in unopposed on September 10. Their seizure of strategic islands nearby further enhanced their ability to attack Saudi oil shipments in the Red Sea Iranian advisers helped Houthis seize Yemen's Red Sea coast in less than 48 hours: report.

item.title: We have been victims of terrorism: Iran President tells UN in rare wartime address
item.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian held up photos of the late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and the more than 150 school children killed on the first days of the war; The ‌United States delegation walked out ‌at ⁠the start of the speech Tehran will not surrender in war with U. S., but believes in diplomacy: Iran President tells UN. We have been victims of terrorism: Iran President tells UN in rare wartime address.

item.title: Soorya Krishnamoorthy, who dedicated his life to promote arts, passes away in Keralam
item.description: The Soorya Stage and Film Society founded by him has been bringing the best of musicians, dancers and films to Thiruvananthapuram in Keralam every year without fail as part of the Soorya Music, Dance and Film Festival Soorya Krishnamoorthy, who dedicated his life to promote arts, passes away in Keralam.

item.title: Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran
item.description: An Afghan migrant reported that his stepmother and four sisters died An Afghan migrant has told RFE/RL's Radio Azadi that his stepmother and four sisters died of thirst and hunger while attempting a dangerous journey to Iran after economic hardship forced the family to leave Afghanistan again. Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran.

item.title: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby
item.description: Venezuela’s interim president hails ‘historic meeting’ and does not say whether she will visit snatched predecessorVenezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has celebrated a “historic” meeting with Donald Trump in New York, posing for a smiley photo with the US president, less than nine months after he ordered the abduction of her boss, Nicolás Maduro. Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby.

item.title: Equality ‘ends at the doors of the Security Council’, Kenya’s Ruto tells General Assembly
item.description: Kenyan President William Ruto told the General Assembly on Wednesday that the sovereign equality the UN proclaims is contradicted by its own structures, urging Member States to reform the Security Council and an international financial system “built for another age”. Equality ‘ends at the doors of the Security Council’, Kenya’s Ruto tells General Assembly.

item.title: Rohingya refugees deserve a future beyond survival, not endless displacement
item.description: Nine years after the mass displacement of the Rohingya from Myanmar, their situation remains one of the world's most protracted and complex refugee crises, marked by years of persecution and uncertainty over the prospect of returning home. Rohingya refugees deserve a future beyond survival, not endless displacement.

item.title: Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for intensified pressure on Russia to end its war against Ukraine, arguing that Moscow continues to incur massive losses while prolonging a conflict whose consequences are increasingly being felt far beyond the battlefield. Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine.

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic brief Security Council amid ‘real and imminent’ threat posed by runaway AI
item.description: The Security Council has been briefed by some of the world's top AI executives on the huge benefits and huge risks the frontier technology presents. With warnings mounting that the world may be losing its grip on systems built to outthink us, Yoshua Bengi, a recipient of the prestigious Turing Award and one of the Godfathers of machine intelligence, said the dangers of AI beyond human control repr.

item.title: Climate change is here - What happens next is still in our hands
item.description: 🔴 LIVE NOW From deadly floods in the Himalayas to wildfires and extreme heat across Europe, 2026 has brought a succession of stark reminders of a changing climate. The task is immediate: Protect people from the impacts already unfolding while rapidly cutting the emissions of harmful gasses driving climate change. World leaders are meeting today to discuss how to turn those priorities into action.

item.title: UN’s ‘sacred covenant has been broken’, Argentina’s Milei tells General Assembly
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei told the General Assembly on Wednesday that the UN has broken the “sacred covenant” on which it was founded, failing at what it was meant to do – while excelling at things beyond its remit. UN’s ‘sacred covenant has been broken’, Argentina’s Milei tells General Assembly.

item.title: World leaders debate ongoing war in Ukraine
item.description: Five years of war. Another winter closing in. Today, the Security Council once again debates a path to peace – though any resolution still runs up against the veto of Russia, one of its own permanent members, whose objections have repeatedly stalled any consensus. As world leaders take the floor, the gap between diplomatic process and battlefield reality appears to be stark.

item.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths
item.description: More than 130 days into the latest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), health experts said on Wednesday that response efforts have been scaled up significantly and “the first encouraging signs of progress” are now being seen. DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths.

item.title: US Set To Unveil Next Steps for Trump-Backed Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Corridor
item.description: The United States is set to unveil the next stage of TRIPP, a planned transport corridor through southern Armenia that Washington says could open new trade routes linking the South Caucasus and Central Asia with Western markets. US Set To Unveil Next Steps for Trump-Backed Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Corridor.

item.title: Indian billionaire’s payments firm plots biggest London flotation in years
item.description: Sunil Bharti Mittal’s Airtel Money targets $9bn IPO in boost for ailing UK stock marketNils Pratley: Does this mark the end of London’s listing drought? Not yetA payments business that operates across Africa and is ultimately controlled by an Indian billionaire has announced its intention to float on the struggling London Stock Exchange. Indian billionaire’s payments firm plots biggest London flotation in years.

item.title: Iranian Hard-Liners Up In Arms After Araqchi-Witkoff Meeting In New York
item.description: Iranian hard‑liners condemned the meeting between US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi in New York on US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi met in New York on September 22 following days of signals that US-Iranian talks would take place on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. The meeting sparked a backlash from Iranian hard-liners.
